data.comment:
# Comfy HeyGen- Avatar Video

Create an AI avatar video from a text prompt or uploaded image using HeyGen's avatar generation technology, outputting a single talking-head video. You can save the avatar ID for reuse in future videos. Ideal for personalized digital presenters, social media content creation, and multilingual video production without recording talent. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_heygen_avatar_video.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.speech.text: This is a demo showing how to generate videos using preset avatars. You can also create your own custom avatar.
